meta.title: Questions, information and answers that must be addressed before any reasonable decision — organized by what we have and do not have
meta.policy: Every row states a question, the information needed to answer it, the best answer from the current data (or blank if unverified), and a suggestion for discovering the missing piece. No row invents a number.

rows.question: Can the closing line be beaten by our model?
rows.information_needed: Model spread MAE vs market MAE on same walk-forward window, plus incremental regression of (actual−close) on (ours−close)
rows.answer: No. Market MAE 10.25 pts (n=7087); model MAE 10.39 pts walk-forward 2023-2026; incremental coefficient c=-0.019 (p=0.881). The model adds nothing beyond the close.
rows.suggestion_if_missing: Re-run scripts/analyze_model.py with frozen 2021-2022 hyperparameters and check data/derived/model.json accuracy_spread and incremental_information.

rows.question: Is the spread market exploitable on average?
rows.information_needed: Pooled ATS coin-flip test over all settled spread bets with push-aware settlement at closing prices
rows.answer: No. 13,784 settled spread team-games; pooled cover rate 50.0%; binomial p vs 50% = 1.0. Blind backing of any side loses to vig (home -4.89% at stored prices).
rows.suggestion_if_missing: Re-settle from games.csv.gz with spread_line sign convention proved (positive = home favoured, corr 0.425) and moneyline cross-check.

rows.question: Did any candidate strategy pass the validation gates?
rows.information_needed: Gate matrix G1-G10 per strategy, with n, ROI, p-value, sample-size gate, FDR, stability, executable check
rows.answer: No. 0 of 7 candidates (plus 2 controls) approved; every candidate fails at least 5 gates. Best gated count 5/10 (divisional home underdog, ROI -1.21%).
rows.suggestion_if_missing: Read data/derived/strategies.json and data/derived/leaderboard.json; each failed gate is listed in failed array.

rows.question: Are same-game parlay legs independent?
rows.information_needed: Pearson r between per-team-game quantities (QB passing yards, WR1/WR2 receiving yards, RB rushing yards, home cover vs over)
rows.answer: No. QB→WR1 r=0.562 (n=7560); WR1↔WR2 r=0.120; home-cover vs over φ=0.016. 4-leg same-team joint 11.1% vs product 5.7% — independence understates joint rate by factor ~1.95.
rows.suggestion_if_missing: Compute via NIST Pearson formula over games.csv.gz + player_week.csv.gz per-team-game legs; verify with verification/recompute.py (49 checks, 45 pass).

rows.question: Is a season win-loss record a reusable signal?
rows.information_needed: Pythagorean expectation vs actual win%, SD of luck wins, year-over-year luck correlation
rows.answer: Mostly no. Pythagorean R²=0.819 over 877 team-seasons (exponent 2.37); luck SD=1.32 wins; y-o-y luck r=0.024 (p=0.49, n=842). Records are mostly noise beyond points scoring.
rows.suggestion_if_missing: Extend analysis to larger sample (877 seasons) to confirm R² and sd_luck_wins in data/derived/luck.json.

rows.question: Can prop ROI be measured from the current feed?
rows.information_needed: Historical player-prop market prices (opening and closing) with timestamps aligned to player-game outcomes
rows.suggestion_if_missing: Leave cells blank per verification policy. Discovery path: confirm via NFL official data partner announcement that prop and SGP pricing is distributed to operators via Genius, not to this project (flagged high severity). Do not fabricate -110 assumptions; only calibration and MAE vs naive baseline are publishable.

rows.question: Do the published numbers survive an independent recomputation?
rows.information_needed: Independent re-implementation that imports nothing from scripts/ or pipeline/ and reconciles standings vs NFL.com
rows.answer: Yes, arithmetically: 45 of 49 checks agree, 0 material disagreements (11 observations expected to differ due to window pruning). 2020 32/32 teams match NFL.com; 2026 32/32 match through 2026-11-01.
rows.suggestion_if_missing: Run verification/recompute.py (scipy/pandas/numpy only) and compare committed JSON vs recomputed; see data/derived/verification.json.

rows.question: Which defenses or offenses are currently deficient because starters are out?
rows.information_needed: Live weekly injury reports (practice participation + game status) joined to official depth charts with First/Second/Third/Fourth columns, yielding per-team deficiency tier
rows.suggestion_if_missing: SUG-03: build pipeline that ingests nfl.com/injuries/league/<season>/regN at 4pm ET filing deadline (required by Important Dates), and depth charts from colts.com/team/depth-chart and nfl.com/teams/<team>/roster; publish per-team deficiency: e.g., PIT OT starter questionable → backup LT Fred Johnson. Do not infer tiers beyond roster sentence.

rows.question: Are backups on specific position groups materially worse than starters?
rows.information_needed: Starter vs backup performance deltas measured on team-seasons where depth-deficiency changed, using point-in-time roster data
rows.suggestion_if_missing: Once tracker (Q-08) exists, compute for each team×week×position whether Out/Doubtful starter was replaced by 2nd/3rd/4th string backup (depth rank from depth chart), then measure margin and EPA deltas vs market expectation; gate through FDR control before publication.

rows.question: What price and size is actually obtainable for a given bet at a given time?
rows.information_needed: Verified sportsbook account, limit and jurisdiction for the exact market and timestamp (G9 executable gate)
rows.suggestion_if_missing: Flagged high severity: no verified execution access, limits, jurisdiction or price availability. To discover, open account with licensed operator filed under MGC/Nevada Regulation 22, record offer timestamp vs close, and publish eligibility per jurisdiction. Until then every strategy fails G9 by construction.

rows.question: Is the weather signal real or an artifact of missing coverage and price assumptions?
rows.information_needed: Outdoor stadiums matched to NWS point forecasts with wind_gust/temp/precip and weather_available boolean; ROI settled only at stored prices with exclusion counts
rows.answer: Marginal on stored prices: wind-under 46 bets, ROI +1.51% (not significant); earlier +8.65% over 649 included 219 no-price rows. Historical weather coverage ~57% outdoor 2020-2026. No current live fill.
rows.suggestion_if_missing: SUG-06: add per-game weather_available flag and enforce stored-price-only settlement (n_excluded_missing_price=1902). Re-measure only on weather_available games; gate through FDR.

rows.question: Has luck been removed from the leaderboard ranking?
rows.information_needed: Deflated Sharpe / permutation null distribution calibrated to number of variants tried, plus public/private split to block overfitting
rows.have_or_missing: have (as design, not as funded prize)
rows.answer: Design is published: deflated Sharpe p-value per strategy, BH q=0.10 across 9 tests, and Kaggle-style public/private split. On the data tried, no strategy passes after luck adjustment. Reward pool not funded — paper schedule only.
rows.suggestion_if_missing: Extend luck.json with permutation null per strategy and document private leaderboard holdout window (e.g., last 4 weeks never used for tuning).

rows.question: Can we be sure we did not hallucinate or mistype a number?
rows.information_needed: Deterministic build from committed JSON plus strict-JSON and per-row source checks with recomputed verification
rows.answer: Build is deterministic: scripts/build_site.py writes byte-identical output on re-run; tests/check_site.py fails on any table row without source link (85 pages, 221 tables, 3348 links, 0 broken on last main); tests/check_derived.py fails on non-strict JSON and on verification disagreement.
rows.suggestion_if_missing: Run python scripts/build_site.py twice and diff; run verification/recompute.py standalone; confirm 0 material disagreements.

rows.question: Where does the reward money come from and who judges the competition?
rows.information_needed: Funded prize pool, judging criteria, and anti-cheat rules for the leaderboard
rows.suggestion_if_missing: Leave reward column labelled as schedule not promise; mode is on NFL Big Data Bowl precedent ($100,000 pool judged by 32 NFL club analytics staff on Kaggle). To make funded, would need sponsor, published rules, and independent audit per Kaggle docs anti-cheat (no private-window tuning, bet logs auditable vs official stats).

rows.question: Are any of the official source URLs no longer serving content?
rows.information_needed: HTTP status and excerpt re-checked on 2026-11-12 for legacy URLs
rows.answer: Several legacy links now 404 or empty: operations.nfl.com/the-rules/2025-nfl-rulebook (404), operations.nfl.com/football-ops/league-governance/injury-report/ (no article body), nflreadr dictionary_games.html (404). All are flagged low severity and none is linked from published navigation (current rulebook URL verified).
rows.suggestion_if_missing: SUG-04 and SUG-12: replace with verified current URLs (2026 rulebook, active 10.7.26 house rules) and publish 404 list on Flagged page.
